properties.name: scoring_follows_the_test_gate
properties.statement: ∀ g, e.invoked g "synth.reaction.23" → ∃ g', e.completed g' "synth.reaction.22" ∧ (e.wrote g' "synth.reaction.22" "synth.gated").isSome
properties.proof:
by
  intro g hinv
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hid, t, ht, htrig⟩ := invoked_from hv hinv
  simp [topology] at hr
  rcases hr with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp at hid
  simp at ht
  subst ht
  rcases htrig with hp | ⟨tm, htm, -⟩
  · obtain ⟨v, hv'⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp hp
    rcases present_from hv hv' with ⟨g', id, hw, hc, hwr, hl⟩ | ⟨c, hc, -⟩ | ⟨port, hport, hn, hk, -⟩
    · simp [topology, Topology.writers, Topology.Reaction.mayWrite] at hw
      subst hw
      exact ⟨g', hc, by simp [hwr]⟩
    · simp [topology, Topology.sources] at hc
    · simp [topology] at hport
      rcases hport with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp_all
  · simp [topology] at htm
